name: budgeting-app
description: Budget: the web app (repo root, served by GitHub Pages) and its Android app (android/, built with Capacitor).

scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:
npm run sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21) ./gradlew assembleRelease && echo "
App file: android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk"
